description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which implements the LogNode interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to allow logging messages with additional processing and chaining functionality.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface. It forwards log messages to the Android Log and can pass logs to a subsequent LogNode.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to which log data will be sent after this node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority and tag. If an exception is provided, its stack trace is appended. Passes the log to the next node if present.
